resolved_conflicts.explanation: Tennessee Landforms lists a different Liberty tower in Madison County (MDT002), which matches the register's Liberty Lookout Tower (1), US 1754. The Bradley County record is the US 820 entry.
Tennessee Landforms gives the N4AOW Tower as 1061 ft; the register gives 1,038 ft (316 m). The record keeps the register's figure.

notes_for_editor: The N4AOW Tower in Tennessee Landforms is linked to this record by county match and the reassembly article; no source says outright that they are the same structure. Former-tower identities (Sparta, Sale Creek) come only from the register. The record's agency field holds an owner's name; consider moving it to ownership. Tennessee Landforms lists a separate Sale Creek tower in Hamilton County (HMT003) as removed; its link to the register's Sale Creek former tower is unverified and not used. No new photos.
